title: hydrangea arborescens subsp. discolor
intro: Hydrangea arborescens subsp. discolor, commonly known as Smooth White Wild Hydrangea, is a deciduous shrub native to Eastern North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and relieving menstrual cramps due to its emmenagogic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea arborescens subsp. discolor include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
